summaries.Romania: Romania faces economic instability concerns as political uncertainty deters foreign investment, while healthcare innovation advances with the country's first neonatal MRI installation. Security threats emerge with Russian sabotage attempts detected by intelligence services.
summaries.Healthcare: Healthcare AI adoption accelerates with major funding rounds and new platforms, while questions persist about AI's actual clinical impact and readiness gaps in implementation. Behavioral health and addiction treatment see expanded funding and innovative care delivery models.
summaries.Tech: Apple's foldable iPhone Duo launches today as the company's biggest product event in years, signaling major competition in the foldable market. AI safety concerns intensify as researchers warn of existential risks, while major AI labs continue aggressive development and funding rounds.

items.title: Meta debuts its Muse AI agent. Will consumers trust it?
items.snippet: Meta's new personal AI agent Muse wants access to users' email, calendars, payments, health services, and more — making the company's biggest consumer AI bet yet a major test of whether people still trust Meta with their data.
items.line: Meta launches Muse personal AI agent requesting access to users' emails, payments, and health data—a major consumer trust test for AI with significant privacy implications.

items.title: Raport american: Instabilitatea politică ține investițiile pe loc în România. Heritage cere accelerarea reformelor
items.snippet: România este unul dintre cei mai fiabili aliați ai Statelor Unite pe flancul estic al NATO, însă instabilitatea legislativă și deficiențele de guvernanță economică limitează potențialul relației economice dintre cele două țări, arată un raport al Heritage Foundation. Think tank-ul american recomandă
items.line: Heritage Foundation report warns that Romania's legislative instability and governance deficiencies limit economic partnership with the US despite being NATO's most reliable Eastern flank ally.

items.title: STAT+: Can AI fix health care? In the chaos of emergency rooms, the technology comes up short
items.snippet: CEOs of the biggest AI companies have predicted the technology will “eliminate most cancer” and “improve treatment of most other ailments.” But nowhere better illustrates the challenge facing AI than…
items.line: Study finds AI falls short in chaotic healthcare environments like emergency rooms despite CEO promises to eliminate cancer, exposing the gap between AI hype and real-world clinical deployment.

items.title: Smart ring maker Oura files to go public, pitching investors on AI-driven preventive health
items.snippet: Oura, the smart ring maker and health tracking company, filed to go public on Thursday to fuel its next phase of growth as it aims to build an artificial intelligence-powered health platform.
items.line: Smart ring maker Oura files for IPO, positioning AI-driven preventive health monitoring as the next frontier in consumer health technology and wellness tracking.

items.title: Mistral raises €3B as sovereign AI becomes big business
items.snippet: The French AI lab has raised €3 billion at a €21 billion valuation in a Series D round led by Samsung, Scaleup Europe, and PSG Equity.
items.line: Mistral raises €3B at €21B valuation in Series D, positioning European AI as alternative to US dominance and signaling massive capital flows into sovereign AI development.
